resources.string: Countdown while burning; tap to open the timer
Today and this week against your burn goals

Keeps your burns and limits. It sends you away from a blocked app or site while you burn, and stands in front of whatever a closed limit covers. While limits are on it also stands in front of the switches that would turn it off. It reads the app in front, a browser\'s address bar and those few Settings pages. Only the site names it notes are kept, and they go only to your own server.
